CharacterDescription: Ser Wylis Manderly known as the Fat Bugger is the eldest son and heir of Lord Wyman Manderly of White Harbor - a very large man in his thirties, formidable despite his size, who has trained as a knight with the dedication of someone who knows people underestimate him. He has his father's intelligence and political sophistication dressed in a body that invites dismissal. He is riding with Robb Stark's forces. The Manderlys are committed to the Stark cause and Wylis has put himself in the field to make that commitment tangible.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Ser Wylis Manderly, known as 'The Fat Bugger' is a knight of House Manderly. He is the eldest son and heir of Wyman Manderly, Lord of White Harbor.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: With Robb Stark's forces in the Riverlands two days before Ned's execution.
